capabilities: Generate seeded town, region, dungeon, ship and building maps inside notes via mapsmith code blocks
Click numbered map places to see names, keepers and hooks and open a note for each place
Explore maps solo with fog of war, secret-door searches and state written back into the block
Save player-facing maps as PNG images sized for virtual tabletop grids
Export Universal VTT files with walls, doors and lights using a paid Pro key
extras: Freemium: all map generation is free; a one-time $6 Pro key unlocks Save for virtual tabletop (.dd2vtt). A browser version with the same maps and saves exists outside Obsidian. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate or draw game maps inside notes, so TTRPG players must make them in outside tools and paste in pictures.

relations.evidence: Its hex notes put a mapsmith block in each town and ruin, so Mapsmith draws the streets
Atlas VTT imports it as it is, the battle-map plugin for Obsidian
Foundry reads it with the Universal Battlemap Importer module
Roll20 takes it from Create Page, Upload Background

requires.name: Mapsmith Pro key ($6 once on itch)

summary: Seed-based map generator for TTRPGs that draws towns, regions, dungeons, ships and building floor plans in notes, with numbered clickable places.
